transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
I'd like to book with Dr. Smith.
Happy to help. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Lena Hoffmann, April seventeenth, nineteen eighty-three.
Thanks, Lena. Are you a new or existing patient?
What insurance provider do you have?
I don't have insurance right now.
No problem, I've noted that. Dr. Smith can see you Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
You're all set for Wednesday at 2 PM. Goodbye.
